question: How does temporal chunk partition change decoding of the same fixed 14-frame latent under the released SVD VAE?

latent_protocol.video_latent: Repeat identical mode 14 times, multiply by0.18215; upstream decode_latents reverses scaling

budget.any_failed_or_timed_out_command: Stop sequence; remaining commands not attempted; preserve all records.
budget.first_gate: Proceed after chunk14 only when wall<=240 and queried peakRSS<=12GiB.
budget.resource_scope: Small144x256 VAE-only inference; no UNet/CLIP load; actual RSS post-run. Memory ceiling is a continuation gate, not a kernel-enforced memory limit.

outputs: All raw float32 B,C,F,H,W arrays and intermediate inputs retained locally; JSON metrics, command logs/records, hashes and comparisons archived.

comparisons.required_identity: Compare normalized_input, latent_mode and video_latents bytewise across all completed runs before assigning differences to chunk partition.
comparisons.primary: Per-frame and global float64 RMS/max absolute raw decoder output differences relative to chunk14.
comparisons.secondary: Raw adjacent-frame RMS, range/outside[-1,1], command wall, decoder-only time, queried process peakRSS. Display clipping values kept separate if reported.
comparisons.analytic_invariance: Identical inputs imply repeated independent chunk1 outputs and repeated7-frame segments for chunk7 under deterministic identical execution; record exact equality and float64 residual, rather than presupposing bitwise identity on every platform.
comparisons.no_required_difference: Zero or nonzero differences are both retained; no minimum visual or numerical effect required.
comparisons.population_inference: Single fixed reference and latent protocol; no confidence interval, video-generation quality ranking or diagnosis of prior denoising failure.

commit_requirement: Plan and script are committed before first model run; coordinator checks plan bytes against HEAD and frozen source hashes.
